title: EngineError
description: The structured error value carried in a ResponseFrame's 'error' member. Errors are values: this is the only way an operation fails. Taxonomy and details conventions in spec.md §10.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Open vocabulary; unknown codes are handled by the category fallback (spec.md §10.2).

category.description: Coarse classification enabling handling of unknown codes. Absent or unknown is treated as 'internal'.

message.description: Human-readable description, not intended for programmatic dispatch.

details.description: Code-specific structure per spec.md §10.2 — e.g. 'supported' (protocol-version-unsupported), 'op' (operation-unsupported), 'problems: [{path, message}]' (interaction-invalid/pact-invalid), 'component' and opaque 'error' (component-*).
